stem: Voltmarkt's position-based model gives 40% to the first touch, 40% to the last and shares 20% among the touches in between. A path with one touch gives it the whole order, and a path with two touches splits the order evenly. Order 1, €300: display → paid search. Order 2, €500: paid search. Order 3, €250: social → email → paid search. How much revenue does paid search get, in euros with 2 decimals?
